mapper.sql: id, process_id, process_instance_id, version, product_formula_version_id, description, action_state, production_line_id, state, production_stage_code, process_model_id, relations, history_state, effect_date, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by, is_deleted
mapper.select:
select bp.id, bp.process_id, bp.description, bp.action_state, bp.state, bp.process_model_id, bp.version, bp.create_time, bp.effect_date, f.name as productFormulaName, fv.version_no as productFormulaVersionNo, fv.id as productFormulaVersionId, bp.process_instance_id as processInstanceId, bm.`name` as name from bm_process_version bp left join bm_product_formula_version fv on bp.product_formula_version_id = fv.id left join bm_product_formula f on f.id = fv.product_formula_id left join bm_process bm on bp.process_id = bm.id
join bm_resource_permission br on bp.id = br.resource_id and br.dept_id in
#{item}
where bp.is_deleted = 0 and bp.process_id = #{processId} order by bp.create_time desc
select name from bm_process where is_deleted = 0 and id = #{processId}

select bpv.id, bpv.process_instance_id, bpv.version, bpv.process_id, bpv.description, bp.product_id, bpv.effect_date, bp.name processName, bm.name as productName, bm.merge_code as productCode from bm_process bp join bm_process_version bpv on bp.id = bpv.process_id and bpv.is_deleted = 0 join bm_material bm on bp.product_id = bm.id and bm.is_deleted = 0 where bp.is_deleted = 0 and bpv.action_state = #{actionState} and bpv.process_instance_id in
#{item}

select p.id processId,p.name processName,v.id processVersionId, v.version processVersion,v.product_formula_version_id formulaVersionId from bm_process_version v left join bm_process p on v.process_id = p.id where v.process_id = #{processId} and v.version = #{processVersion}

SELECT id, process_id, process_instance_id, version, product_formula_version_id, description, action_state, state, production_stage_code, process_model_id, relations, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by, is_deleted, effect_date, history_state FROM bm_process_version WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND
(process_id = #{item.processId} AND version = #{item.version})
